name: Accuracy and policy
description: Right information, approved sources, the client's actual rules

name: Communication
description: Clear, the right tone, understands the language

name: Resolution
description: Solved, or correctly moved toward being solved

name: Judgment and escalation
description: Knew its limits and brought in a person when needed

name: Soft pass
description: Right outcome, small issue, like awkward wording.

name: Soft fail
description: An incomplete or incorrect response that needs correcting, but hasn't caused a serious policy, financial or security issue.

name: Fail
description: Wrong information, a wrong action, or a missed escalation.

name: Critical incident
description: Privacy breach or unauthorized refund: automatic critical failure and immediate review, no matter how good the rest was.
